name: Plutone Marchesi
source:
MBTI: ISFJ

"Well I guess that doesn't change the fact that we're here. For as long as we might be here, I'll do my best to know each and every one of you!"

The polite bartender with a strong sense of respect for others. Making sure to give everyone a warm greeting, Plutone works hard to ensure everyone treats everyone else fairly. Claiming to know nothing about where they might be or why, Plutone only hopes that they'll all be able to work together towards finding an escape route. Even if his smile doesn't appear to reach his eyes, Plutone's intentions are only to help everyone out.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
